not_primary.continuous_landscape_intensity: Not selected: study PA/UA fractions define the landscape groups and have non-comparable scales; MCD12Q1 urban fraction has weak PA support and is compositionally tied to UA.

modeling_constraints: Fit one moderator family at a time.
Retain the moderator main effect and the frozen A2-LC adjustment set.
Do not treat latitude as an ecological mechanism.
Use continuous curves over observed support; no outcome-driven cut points.
Do not jointly label VPD and precipitation as independent primary mechanisms.
